headline.before: Stop being held hostage by your

landing.subheadline: Voltwise reads OMIE in real time, audits your bill with AI, and tells you exactly when to run the dishwasher — in euros, not megawatt-hours.
landing.tagline: Built for Portugal and Spain · OMIE, REE & E-Redes

oracle.title: The Oracle
oracle.body: Hour-by-hour OMIE prices for PT and ES, with Golden Hours and Red Hours highlighted automatically.

auditor.title: The Auditor
auditor.body: Drop your EDP / Endesa PDF here. We extract every kWh and prove how much you could save.

smartGuard.title: Guardian
smartGuard.body: Push and WhatsApp notifications when energy is nearly free — or about to spike.

autoPilot.title: Auto-Pilot
autoPilot.body: Connect a Shelly or Tuya plug and let Voltwise schedule your appliances automatically.

howItWorks.kicker: Three minutes from skeptic to saver
howItWorks.heading: The energy market isn't broken. It's just hidden.

market.title: See the day-ahead market
market.body: We pull MIBEL prices for Portugal and Spain hour by hour. The Oracle shows you the cheapest and most expensive windows — in cents per kWh, not jargon.

audit.title: Audit your last bill
audit.body: Drag in your EDP, Endesa, Iberdrola or Galp PDF. Our AI reads it, matches your consumption against an indexed tariff, and tells you — to the euro — what you would have paid instead.

save.title: Save automatically
save.body: Get push or WhatsApp alerts before energy goes free. Connect a smart plug and Voltwise schedules your dishwasher, EV charger, and water heater on golden hours.

closer.headline: One PDF. Two minutes. Real money back.
closer.body: Most Iberian households are on a fixed tariff that costs around 30% more than indexed. Find out — free, no card, no sales calls.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Voltwise
onboarding.description: One question and you're in. Pick the country your meter is in — then, in a few taps, we'll show you how much you save each month by charging at the right hours. No invoice, no CSV.
